look.name: Neon Halo
look.description: A vivid purple-blue editorial eye look with a soft nude lip, done in about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, neutral medium
steps.tip: Buff a thin layer over the center of your face first, then sheer it outward to keep the skin even but still realistic. Press a little more on the forehead and around the nose if you want the base to look more polished.

steps.title: Concealer, light warm beige
steps.tip: Tap this under your eyes in a small triangle shape to brighten dark circles and puffy eyes. Add a little directly over age spots, then blend with a damp sponge so the edges disappear into your base.

steps.title: Blush, soft mauve
steps.tip: Sweep the color high on the outer cheeks and pull it slightly toward the temples to match the lifted editorial shape. Keep it light near the apples so the eyes stay the focus.

steps.title: Eyeshadow, purple blue duo
steps.tip: Pack the brighter purple over the lid and blend the blue deeper along the outer lid and lower lash line. Use a small fluffy brush to soften the top edge so the color stays bold but airy.

steps.title: Eyeliner, cobalt half-rim
steps.tip: Draw the liner only on the outer half of the upper lash line, then nudge it outward to echo the sharp winged shape. Smudge the lower outer lash line a touch so the eyes look wrapped in color.

steps.title: Eyebrows, soft natural arch
steps.tip: Fill the brows softly along their natural arch so they frame the eye look without looking blocky. Brush through with a spoolie to keep the front edges feathery and clean.

steps.title: Highlighter, icy pearl
steps.tip: Place this on the tops of your cheekbones, the bridge of your nose, and a touch under the brow arch. Keep the glow concentrated in the center of the face so it reflects like studio light.

steps.title: Lip color, muted nude rose
steps.tip: Trace the natural lip shape and fill in with a thin even layer so the mouth reads polished, not glossy. Blot once with a tissue if you want the nude tone to sit closer to the reference.
